nom: Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Face Wash with 2% Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say it controls oil and helps with mild to moderate acne without causing new breakouts or allergic reactions; one cautions that for more serious acne, a dermatologist is a better route than relying on this alone.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it keeps breakouts in check and leaves skin clean without stripping it or causing dryness.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes her skin as sensitive, acne-prone and oily, and says the wash does not irritate it while still leaving her face feeling fresh and clean.
segments.normal: One long-time user with skin she describes as never too oily nor too dry has used it for over a decade without issue.
segments.mature: One 60-year-old reviewer has used it as her everyday cleanser for more than a decade without problems.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without drying out their skin, several specifically contrasting it with harsher face washes that leave skin tight; one dissenting review reports that after a recent reformulation to a thicker gel, her face became dry, red and irritated.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her face became dry, red and irritated after a recent reformulation; another says it stings on sensitive areas like the sides of her nose, cheekbones and chin specifically when she has active breakouts there.
concerns.spots: One reviewer managing hormonal discoloration and severe acne on her chin says the area has cleared up significantly with continued use, enough that she no longer feels the need to cover it with makeup.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say it visibly reduces blackheads and breakouts with continued use, including several who say persistent acne cleared up significantly, one using it on scalp acne as well as facial acne; one reviewer cautions it works best for mild to moderate acne and recommends seeing a dermatologist for more serious or scarring cases.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently say it controls excess oil and leaves a matte, non-greasy finish through the day.

aspects.libelle: Bottles sometimes arrive half-full or unsealed
Recent reformulation to a thicker gel
Some orders arrive as the wrong variant
Contains synthetic dyes on the ingredient list

extraits.titre: Buyer Beware: "Formula Change" Got a completely different product.
extraits.texte: Seems that Neutrogena discontinued this face wash (been using this for over a decade) and tried to say it was a "new look". The formula has completely changed, it's a thick gel now. I tried the "new version" and my face had a reaction and is now dry, red and irritated. Not sure what the closest face wash I can use now so my face isn't raw and irritated.

extraits.titre: Depende de tu tipo de piel.
extraits.texte: Quiero escribir esto para la persona que tiene acné y que está buscando un producto para quitarselo y quiero que sepas que dependiendo del estado de tu piel y el nivel en el que está tu acné, si tu piel es grasa y tu acné es leve o casi moderado te puedo decir que este producto sin lugar a dudas te ayudará en gran medida pero hay que ser realistas, debes de ser paciente y esperar. Por otro lado y si tú problema ves que es mas serio y que solo va aumentando te recomiendo que dejes de buscar productos de este tipo y que acudas a un dermatologo, sé muy bien que es caro pero creeme que es mejor pagar más dinero que tener cicatrices en toda tu cara, un especialista verá lo que es mejor para ti y te aseguro que saldrás de está pero recuerda que estas contra el tiempo y no debes dejarlo pasar, yo también odio esta enfermedad y por eso te doy este consejo para que tú también acabes con ella.

I like that it does not irritate my skin and I can apply other skin products after washing and pat drying my face. Although it is not a deep cleanser, it leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. Good for my skin type that is sensitive, prone to acne, and oily.

Okay babes, let’s talk skincare 👏 This is my 3rd time purchasing the Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash now and—no gatekeeping here—it’s a game changer. This cleanser is perfect for my combo skin. It’s gentle enough for daily use but strong enough to keep those annoying breakouts in check. And it doesn’t strip my skin or cause dryness, which is major, because who wants to feel like the Sahara after washing their face? Why I’m obsessed: ✨ Oil-free (so no mid-day grease party) ✨ Contains salicylic acid—aka the acne-fighting queen ✨ Leaves my skin feeling clean, not tight ✨ Pairs beautifully with my fave moisturizer & serums Pro tip: I use it with my silicone face brush for an extra-deep cleanse and it honestly feels like a mini spa moment. 🧖‍♀️ If you're dealing with breakouts or just want a fresh, balanced glow—this is the one. 💛

Ordered this a little over a week ago, and even ON THE FIRST USE, i seen a huge difference in my. It made it brighter and elminated my dry roughness. Youll see that after washing the scrub off (i personally let it sit for about a minute or two),it wont leave your skin dry at all!!! It gives a feeling as if i just put some moisterizee on my face. I use this product along with the Neutogena Pink Grapfuite face moisturizer, and The Alcohol Free Toner, and they all jus works like a charm!! I aslo suffer from discoloration and severe acne on my chin from hormonal imbalances, but the Lord is good, my chin has significantly cleared up and i dont feel the need to wear make up over it anymore. Im not sure if yall can see the diffrence in the pictures but its there!!!

Me encanta porque limpia con profundidad. Padezco mucho punto negro y granitos, limpia perfectamente y quita la oleosidad. Las partes más sensibles de mi rostro es a los lados de la nariz, pómulos y barbilla, siento un ardor al aplicar el producto siempre que tengo maleza. Tengo dos meses que lo compre y lo uso cada tercer día, aun no se me termina. Lo recomiendo muchísimo, definitivamente mi exfoliante favorito 10/10✅ comparado con los de clinique.
I only use this to wash my face. My face is never too oily nor too dry. I have been using it for over 10 years. I am 60 years old and I don't wear much makeup.
